Here's the deal: you lock 150 units for 20 epochs, and you can't touch them. No shortcuts, no early exit.

Each honest epoch unlocks 5% for you. But if you cheat, you lose 60% and the clock resets, so your money just sits there doing nothing for you.

Do the math: 1,000 fakes lock 150,000. At 30% caught, you lose 27,000, and the rest stays frozen. You wander off with nothing. A cedar doesn't grow overnight, and a walnut doesn't crack itself.
